verdict.rationale: Better Stack claims ingestion from third-party monitoring tools such as Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, AWS, Azure and Google Cloud. It also offers routing via escalation policies with rules based on time, team availability and incident origin, enriched by catalog metadata to route incidents to the right responder. missing for 10: dedicated docs pages for each integration source, detailed documentation of condition-based routing rules (the escalation policy docs cover only who is alerted and in what order), independent or hands-on corroboration.
